summary: Spec fidelity: brief F2/F3 keep the text 'reason' unchanged, but the time-limit finding now goes through reason_and_cut (mod.rs finish_as, the ran-over-time-limit branch); the old code printed it whole, so a killed call whose argv passes 240 characters now reads cut with an ellipsis and '(all in --json findings)' in the text line. findings[] keeps the whole message, so nothing is lost for a wrapper; only the one text reason differs from 0.34. Blast radius: only an argv over ~170 characters that runs past the time limit; no test seeds that case (scenario 81 plants a long message through another condition).
